testsuite.name: C2A — the concept-enrichment experiment (H1, H2, H3) on the 29-case evaluation

testcase.name: the baseline row judges all 29 cases, and the official reference is recorded
the dataset is the 29 cases of the versioned evaluation
every definition and every relation is a verbatim span of its source document
the top-1 metric looks at the top-ranked claim, not at the first gold
every gold proposition of an answerable case is a claim of its workspace
the supported answer honours the case's own gold condition
the metrics are the frozen ones, and they are internally consistent
every candidate reports the scale of what it touched
the results are bound to the freeze by its SHA-256
every baseline failure carries a classification and its evidence
the corpus the extraction reads is the corpus the manifest names
the candidates change the concepts and never the claims
the MRR is the reciprocal rank of the TOPMOST gold, and the misses count
the extraction is grounded: every candidate carries a verbatim, located span
every scope of the dataset was prepared with the production methods
the tight rule keeps fewer definitions than the loose one
the H4 classification is per gold, and the mixed cases are named
